==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Curses]])
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of Curses [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
